title: crataegus pubescens
intro: Crataegus pubescens, commonly known as the downy hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing blood pressure, improving heart function, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of C. pubescens are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective properties, which are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The flavonoids present in the plant, such as quercetin and epicatechin, are believed to be responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
